resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During its first turn, the Slayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the Slayer scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the Slayer's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Slayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Slayer makes four Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. The Slayer deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage when it has advantage on the attack roll and hits the target.
